tools.name: search_history
tools.description: Search local coding agent history (Codex CLI, AGY CLI, Pi) to pinpoint when and who made a decision. BEST FIRST STEP: call with group_by='session' (e.g. query='中文 | english', group_by='session') to locate the right session(s) cleanly, then call get_session_digest. Default searches human prompts, assistant replies, inter-agent messages, and tool calls (excluding noisy tool outputs & injected prompts).

query.description: Keywords, `A | B` OR, `-term`/`-"phrase"` negation, `prefix*` wildcard, quoted phrases, or inline filters (`agent:agy role:user project:foo since:7d @sid8`).

case.description: Case matching: smart (default: case-sensitive if query has uppercase), insensitive, or sensitive.

fixed.description: Literal fixed-string substring match (-F), disabling query syntax parsing.

regex.description: PCRE2 JIT regular expression match (-E) with automatic literal/index prefiltering.

role.description: Comma-separated filter: user, assistant, inter_agent, tool_call, tool_result, thinking, system.

group_by.description: Set to 'session' to group hits by session with agent, date, title, hit count, and best snippet (ideal first step before get_session_digest).

count_by.description: Return grouped counts by: agent, role, project, actor, session.

no_dedup.description: Disable exact-duplicate folding across forked/retried transcripts.

tools.name: get_session_digest
tools.description: Return the condensed chronological user<->assistant decision stream of a single session (by @prefix or full session_id). Collapses intermediate tool calls into counts, skips duplicate retries, and keeps ending options/conclusions intact within an inline-friendly byte budget.

max_bytes.description: Optional text budget in bytes (default 7200). Omit this parameter to keep output inline; values >8000 may spill to disk and require an extra read turn.

include_tools.description: Include tool_call records instead of collapsing them.

tools.name: get_decision_timeline
tools.description: Return chronological (oldest-first) hits across MULTIPLE sessions for a topic. Do NOT call this in parallel with search_history(group_by='session'); prefer search_history(group_by='session') -> get_session_digest when investigating a feature or single-session decision.

query.description: Topic or keyword to trace over time.

tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Fetch surrounding dialogue turns around a matched doc_id within the same session (collapses intermediate tool calls by default).

doc_id.description: Document id returned by search_history or get_decision_timeline.

window.description: Number of dialogue turns before and after anchor (default 5).

include_tools.description: Include tool calls instead of collapsing them.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read full or paginated content of one or more documents (pass doc_id, OR batch doc_ids:[id1,id2,...] up to 16 in a single call instead of scripting loops), or fetch raw JSONL via O(1) pread. Note: doc_ids include hidden tool_call records and are NOT contiguous dialogue turns — use get_session_context(doc_id) for neighboring dialogue instead of guessing adjacent doc_ids.

doc_ids.description: Batch of up to 16 document IDs to read in one call (preferred over loops).

raw.description: Read raw JSONL line from original transcript file.

limit.description: Max bytes per document (default 7200 for single doc, auto-budgeted for batch).

tail.description: Read from the end (useful for error logs).

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List local Codex, AGY, and Pi sessions sorted by most recent activity, with auto-extracted titles.

tools.name: search_file_history
tools.description: Find which sessions, when, and who created or edited files matching a path substring.

file.description: File path or filename substring (e.g. rate_limit.rs or DESIGN.md).
